what_happened.line: The Municipal Building Design Committee took no votes and went through the departmental space-needs list from the earlier TC Passios reuse study.
Members discussed reprioritizing the list, including whether school programs such as Extended Day and ACE belong in town-funded space.
Records storage emerged as a major space driver; the chair will send questions to the town manager and, by email, the superintendent.
The committee agreed to ask the superintendent where Extended Day and other school uses could go if TC Passios is unavailable.
The second April meeting was cancelled; the next meetings were set for May 2 and May 16.

why_it_matters: How much space the town plans for, and which uses (school programs, records, the performing arts studio) are counted in it, sets the size of any building project that residents would later be asked to fund.
School uses at TC Passios would not get state building-authority cost sharing, so whether they sit in a town-funded project bears directly on what falls to local taxpayers.
watch_next: Committee meeting on May 2, followed by May 16.
The town manager's and superintendent's replies on records handling and where school programs could go.
